Huafeng Technology.why: Makes high-speed backplane connectors and high-speed cable modules for AI servers and data centers (112G in volume production, 224G in mass production since June 2026), so AI-server build-out drives its main growth.
Huafeng Technology.evidence: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026): AI-server and data-center demand drove revenue growth, with core products such as high-speed cable modules raising their penetration in leading server equipment; 112G products in stable volume production and delivery, entering the supply chain of mainstream computing equipment.

players.product: 112G / 224G high-speed backplane cable modules and backplane connectors, CPU sockets for AI servers

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, general manager and board secretary): the new-generation high-speed cable module is far more complex to make than the previous generation and its ramp has taken somewhat longer than originally planned, but production is now in good shape; new-generation yield is up about 10 to 20 percentage points from earlier, depending on part number, and management expects further improvement in Q4 as processes are optimized and volume-production experience builds. It said 224G-related products have achieved volume delivery.
quarterly_data.figure: yield up about 10 to 20 percentage points

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): Q2 2026 profit was under pressure from several factors at once: new-generation high-speed cable module yield and efficiency still ramping, slower Q2 delivery of the previous-generation product, raw material price increases and capacity expansion. Since July, production and delivery of the new-generation product have improved markedly, and management expects operating performance to improve gradually in Q3 and Q4. It said the company's market share has not declined, downstream demand for high-speed cable modules is strong, orders are sufficient and no orders have been diverted.

Management (IR record): the company has project cooperation with internet customers Alibaba, ByteDance, Tencent and Baidu and with server makers Inspur, xFusion, Huaqin and Lenovo, with overall progress smooth. Several ByteDance projects are in development in parallel and some products are expected to start mass production in Q4 2026; the Tencent cooperation is ongoing. Management expects the internet customers' share of the business to keep rising over the long term as projects reach mass production, but said optimizing the customer structure takes time.
quarterly_data.figure: some ByteDance products expected in mass production from Q4 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): CPU Socket products have reached small-batch production, and the business is expected to scale up further in 2027.

connects_to.relationship: high-speed cable modules for AI servers

contracts.signal: Management (IR record): the Alibaba project achieved volume delivery in the second half of 2025 (internet-customer projects are landing project by project).

players.product: 112G / 224G high-speed copper backplane cable modules and connectors; NPO sockets and NPO optical modules in development

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the optical-connectivity business, earlier mainly defense supply, now also targets the civilian market, with products along the whole link: NPO sockets, NPO optical modules and NPO passive components, within an NPO / FAU / MPO / AEC optical-electrical product layout. The NPO Socket is being co-developed with a leading chip customer and has completed verification; the NPO optical module is being co-developed with a customer and is at the technical-verification stage. The company is also seeking external growth opportunities to extend its footprint.
